specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette: a friendly cartoon robot stands at a desk in front of an enormous wall covered with millions of tiny faint gray dots (a sea of boring pixels), calmly using a thick marker to trace just a few clean bold orange lines and curves over the dots, while a small overflowing trash bin beside it brims with crumpled discarded dot-papers. The robot wears reading glasses and looks pleasantly decisive, like a ruthless editor keeping only the essentials. The contrast between the vast dull pixel field and the handful of confident lines is the whole point. Friendly and approachable, like an XKCD-inspired comic strip, expressive character, minimal visual clutter, clean white background, generous margins. No text or lettering in the image. Gentle, immediately understandable humor. One clear visual metaphor.
specs.alt: A spectacled cartoon robot at a desk traces a few bold orange lines over a huge wall of millions of faint gray pixel dots, with a trash bin full of discarded dots beside it, dramatizing how an edge detector compresses two million pixel measurements into a handful of meaningful contours.
specs.caption: The edge detector's whole job is ruthless selection: keep the few intensity changes that describe the scene, and let the other 1,999,500 pixels go.

specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette: a velvet-rope nightclub entrance scene rendered gently and kindly. A confident, brightly glowing cartoon dot character (a strong edge) is waved straight through the entrance by a friendly bouncer robot. Beside it, a dimmer pale dot character (a weak edge) is also let in, but only because the glowing strong dot has draped a reassuring arm around it and is vouching for it. Off to the side, a lonely faint speckle dot with no companion is politely turned away, no strong friend to sponsor it. The mood is warm and good-natured, not mean. A clear chain of dots links the strong and weak ones, suggesting connectivity. Friendly approachable style like a comic strip, expressive characters, minimal clutter, clean white background, generous margins. No text or lettering in the image. Gentle humor. One clear visual metaphor.
specs.alt: At a friendly nightclub door, a glowing strong-edge dot is admitted instantly and vouches for a dimmer weak-edge dot beside it, while a lone faint speckle with no sponsor is turned away, illustrating Canny hysteresis where weak pixels are kept only when connected to a strong edge.
specs.caption: Hysteresis is a prior about the world: a faint gradient touching a confident contour is probably that contour continuing, while the same faint gradient alone in the sky is just noise.

specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette: a cheerful election-night scene where many small orange edge-pixel characters line up to drop ballots into labeled ballot boxes that represent candidate lines and shapes. One particular ballot box is overflowing with a tall landslide stack of votes and wears a winner's sash, while several other boxes hold only one or two scattered ballots. A friendly robot returning officer tallies the results on a simple board. The key idea: each little pixel votes independently, and the shape everyone agrees on wins by a landslide. Warm, good-natured civic mood. Friendly approachable comic-strip style, expressive characters, minimal clutter, clean white background, generous margins. No text or lettering in the image. Gentle humor. One clear visual metaphor.
specs.alt: Many small orange edge-pixel characters drop ballots into boxes that stand for candidate lines; one box overflows with a landslide of votes and wears a winner's sash while others hold only stray ballots, depicting the Hough transform detecting a shape by letting every edge pixel vote independently.
specs.caption: Detection becomes an election: every edge pixel votes for the shapes it could belong to, gaps cost only a few absentee votes, and the real line wins by a landslide.

specs.anchorText: hunts for the largest subset that agrees on one model
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette: a split-comparison scene with two panels of the same row of friendly orange dot characters sitting neatly along a gentle diagonal, plus a few gray troublemaker dots loitering far below. In the left panel a stretched red rope is tied to every dot including the distant gray ones, so the rope sags badly and is yanked off course toward the lone outliers (a single stubborn dot dragging the whole line). In the right panel a calm green robot lassos only the large group of agreeing orange dots into a tidy consensus band and simply ignores the gray loiterers, keeping the line straight and true. The contrast: one bad point ruins least squares, while consensus shrugs off outliers. Friendly approachable comic-strip style, expressive characters, minimal clutter, clean white background, generous margins. No text or lettering in the image. Gentle humor. One clear visual metaphor.
specs.alt: Two panels: on the left a red rope tied to every dot, including distant gray outliers, is dragged off course by one stubborn point; on the right a green robot lassos only the large agreeing group into a consensus band and ignores the outliers, contrasting fragile least squares with robust RANSAC.
specs.caption: Least squares gives every outlier a vote and gets dragged off course; RANSAC instead asks who agrees, then keeps only the largest consensus and lets the troublemakers stay off the ballot.

specs.anchorText: do the pieces compose into a system that does something useful
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette: a tidy factory conveyor-belt assembly line staffed by friendly little robots, flowing left to right. At the first station a raw dashcam photo of a curving road enters the belt; the next robot stamps it down to a clean black-and-white evidence mask of glowing stripes; the next robot tilts the road image up into a flat overhead bird's-eye view; the next robot stacks small search-window boxes climbing a near-vertical lane stripe; the final robot hands off a polished output card showing two smooth green lane curves with a curvature arrow and a centered car marker. Each station does one simple job and passes its product to the next. Warm, orderly, cheerful workshop mood. Friendly approachable comic-strip style, expressive robot characters, minimal clutter, clean white background, generous margins. Minimal or no text; at most a couple of tiny incidental labels. Gentle humor. One clear visual metaphor of a staged pipeline.
specs.alt: A factory conveyor line of friendly robots transforms a raw dashcam road photo step by step: into a binary evidence mask, then a flat bird's-eye view, then stacked search windows climbing a lane stripe, and finally an output card with two smooth green lane curves and a curvature arrow, depicting the five-stage lane-detection pipeline.
specs.caption: Each stage is one hand-written prior passed down the line, which is exactly why the lane detector is fast, debuggable, and only as sturdy as its assumptions.

specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette: a good-natured, slightly soggy cartoon robot lane-detector sits in the middle of a road looking baffled and humbled, holding a drooping umbrella in the rain. Around it the road conspires against it: a tree casts a bold dark shadow stripe that the robot has mistakenly traced in bright confident lines, a patch of lane paint is worn away to nothing leaving the robot's marker hovering over bare asphalt, and a glare puddle reflects the sky into a fake bright stripe. The robot's expression is sheepish, not distressed, as if it just realized it had only ever learned to read dry, sunny roads. Warm, sympathetic, gently funny mood. Friendly approachable comic-strip style, expressive character, minimal clutter, clean white background, generous margins. No text or lettering in the image. Gentle humor. One clear visual metaphor of assumptions breaking.
specs.alt: A sheepish, rain-soaked cartoon lane-detector robot under a drooping umbrella has mistakenly traced a tree's shadow as a lane, hovers its marker over a stretch of worn-away paint, and is fooled by a glare puddle reflecting the sky, illustrating the shadow, worn-paint, and glare failure modes of classical lane detection.
specs.caption: Every failure is a named assumption breaking: shadows out-vote faded paint, missing markings cannot be recovered, and wet asphalt mirrors the sky, which is the empirical case for learning the evidence instead of hand-coding it.
